events.<mod id>:<name>: A message from the same mod's code in an app page, sent there with mod.send(topic, data). The detail is {app, data}: the app id and the data as sent.

page: The hub page holds one iframe per app and its own chrome. A mod may draw over it, such as a fixed canvas with pointer-events: none at a z-index from 11 to 14: over the app frames and the loading screen (10), under the hub's toasts (15 and up) and the palette (20).
